verdict.rationale: HumanLayer lets sessions run Claude through Amazon Bedrock instead of the Anthropic API, and you install and authenticate Codex yourself for HumanLayer sessions. That implies the agents run on credentials and accounts you control. A model selector spans the agent backends, and the marketing claims you can bring your own agent harness, but choice appears limited to the supported backends and a short list of models. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of entering your own API keys, support for arbitrary or self-hosted LLMs beyond the Claude/Codex backends, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
